Thomas Jefferson (April 13 [ O.S. April 2], 1743 – July 4, 1826) was an American Founding Father who served as the second vice president of the United States from 1797 to 1801 and as the third president of the United States from 1801 to 1809. [ 3 ] Jefferson was the primary author of the Declaration of Independence . He was a leading proponent of democracy , republicanism , and natural rights , and produced formative documents and decisions at the state, national, and international levels.
